question: Should autoreview adopt the proposed Claude subscription and Bedrock models, effort levels, refusal fallback, provider-authentication routing, and persistent telemetry as defaults for existing users?
rationale: Tests can validate implementation mechanics but cannot determine the intended shared-skill compatibility, provider, and privacy policy.

options.title: Keep behavior opt-in
options.body: Preserve current-main defaults and expose provider routing, fallback, and telemetry through explicit flags or environment settings.

options.title: Adopt new defaults
options.body: Make the proposed behavior standard with documented upgrade, privacy, retention, opt-out, and provider-proof evidence.

options.title: Split the changes
options.body: Review credential-isolation hardening separately from model policy, refusal fallback, and telemetry persistence.

recommendation.title: Keep behavior opt-in
recommendation.body: Preserve current-main defaults and expose provider routing, fallback, and telemetry through explicit flags or environment settings.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this person most strongly to the established autoreview and panel contract.
